SELECT
    toYear(f.DateKey)                                                          AS Year,
    sum(f.SalesAmount)                                                         AS TotalSales,
    sum(f.SalesQuantity)                                                       AS UnitsSold,
    sum(f.TotalCost)                                                           AS TotalCost,
    sum(f.SalesAmount) - sum(f.TotalCost)                                      AS GrossMargin,
    round((sum(f.SalesAmount) - sum(f.TotalCost)) * 100.0
          / nullif(sum(f.SalesAmount), 0), 2)                                  AS GrossMarginPct,
    sum(f.ReturnQuantity)                                                      AS UnitsReturned,
    round(sum(f.ReturnQuantity) * 100.0
          / nullif(sum(f.SalesQuantity), 0), 2)                                AS ReturnRatePct,
    countDistinct(f.SalesOrderNumber)                                          AS NumOrders,
    round(sum(f.SalesAmount)
          / nullif(countDistinct(f.SalesOrderNumber), 0), 2)                   AS AvgOrderValue,
    sum(f.DiscountAmount)                                                      AS TotalDiscounts
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f
JOIN retail.DimProduct p
    ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory sc
    ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = sc.ProductSubcategoryKey
JOIN retail.DimProductCategory cat
    ON sc.ProductCategoryKey = cat.ProductCategoryKey
WHERE cat.ProductCategoryName = 'Cameras'
GROUP BY Year
ORDER BY Year
